newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Cricket-Donald leaves India on brink of defeat.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-Donald leaves India on brink of defeat.

text.p: A fired-up Allan Donald captured two wickets in his first over to leave India on the brink of defeat against South Africa in the first test on Saturday.
Donald removed Vikram Rathore, caught behind for two, and Saurav Ganguly, yorked first ball, for India to totter precariously on two for two in their second innings at lunch on the third day.
India had been set an improbable victory target of 395 after South Africa had earlier been bowled out for 259, with Indian seamer Venkatesh Prasad taking 5-93.
Prasad, who took 10 wickets in a test for the first time, and fellow strike bowler Javagal Srinath had threatened to dominate the morning session at Kingsmead.
South Africa, overnight 164 for four, began the third day disastrously, losing five wickets for the addition of just 21 runs.
But all-rounder Brian McMillan frustrated a buoyant Indian attack with a muscular 51 not out as South Africa eventually opened up their substantial lead.
McMillan and Donald (26) shared a 10th-wicket stand of 74 to frustrate the Indian attack for 11 overs.
Donald survived a sharp chance to fourth slip Anil Kumble off Prasad on six but provided an ideal foil to McMillan with a mixture of inside edges and controlled strokes.
McMillan was severe on anything short of a length and went on to reach his eighth test 50 from just 52 balls with four fours and three sixes.

Earlier, South African captain Hansie Cronje, struggling for test batting form, was caught behind for 17 after edging a Prasad leg-cutter and his overnight partner Herschelle Gibbs departed in the next over, trapped on the back foot for 25 by a Srinath off-cutter.
Shaun Pollock edged Prasad low to second slip, Dave Richardson chopped another Srinath off-cutter on to his stumps for four and Lance Klusener flashed at Srinath to be caught behind for four.
South Africa second innings (overnight 164 for four)
Bowling: Srinath 23-5-80-3 (1-nb), Prasad 25-4-93-5 (2-nb), Johnson 9-1-39-0 (2-nb), Kumble 11-3-26-2, Ganguly 2-0-8-0.
